title: Microsoft 365 OneDrive Usage Report
summary: Read-only Microsoft 365 script for onedrive usage report.
description: Official OperatorOS ScriptForge seed script that collects onedrive usage report data for technician review, reporting, and customer documentation. This script is designed as a read-only audit/reporting baseline.
use_case: Use this script when building a Microsoft 365 health report, onboarding baseline, recurring audit, or escalation packet.

safety.notes: Official OperatorOS read-only audit/reporting seed script. Review tenant scope and permissions before running.

requirements.name: Microsoft Graph PowerShell SDK with read-only Graph permissions.

examples.title: Run report
examples.description: Runs the read-only audit report with default options.

output.description: PowerShell object output suitable for pipeline export, transcript capture, or manual review.

script_body:
# OperatorOS ScriptForge official read-only audit script
# Category: Microsoft 365
# Report: OneDrive Usage Report

$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'

Get-MgReportOneDriveUsageAccountDetail -Period D30

documentation.readme: Official OperatorOS ScriptForge seed script for OneDrive Usage Report. Validate module connection and tenant scope before running.
